note: What a server sends to set which spells a unit casts by itself. The header names the unit.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: The slot cast by itself, from -1 to 51. A client takes a value outside that range as it stands. What -1 does is not recorded.

revisions.note: It names one slot: there is no slot for a critical strike.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: The slot cast by itself, from 0 to 62; any other value leaves it unset.

fields.name: criticalSlot
fields.note: The slot cast by itself on a critical strike, under the same terms.
